memories.title: Two-Level Action Economy Architecture
memories.context: D&D 5e has abilities (Attack, Dash, Dodge) that consume action economy and grant capacity to execute specific actions (Strike, Move). The UI needs to show both levels: what abilities are available, and what actions are available after activation.
memories.decision: Implement two-level system: 1) ActivateCombatAbility consumes action/bonus and grants capacity (e.g., AttacksRemaining=1), 2) ExecuteAction consumes capacity and performs the action (e.g., Strike). API returns both available_abilities and available_actions in responses so UI can render appropriate buttons.
consequences: UI shows base abilities (Attack, Dash, Dodge) computed from ActionEconomy state
After activating Attack, 'Available Strikes' section appears with Strike button
Clear separation: abilities consume resources, actions consume granted capacity
Extensible for Extra Attack (AttacksRemaining=2), Flurry of Blows, etc.
alternatives_considered: Single-level: Attack button directly executes strike - rejected because it hides the two-step nature of D&D combat
Always show Strike: confusing when no attacks granted

memories.description: All major combat pipelines proven end-to-end with real Conditions before API integration.
criteria: AttackChain + DamageChain with advantage/disadvantage, rage bonus, crits
MovementChain with DisengagingCondition prevents OA, Dash doubles movement
Turn lifecycle with temporary action cleanup
Full round with multiple characters and turn order
passing: Action economy flow: Attack ability -> Strike -> OffHandStrike
Two-weapon fighting: light weapon validation, grant flow
Event ordering: events published in correct sequence
Raging Barbarian vs Dodging Defender: AttackChain + DamageChain with real conditions
Disadvantage causes miss: DodgingCondition imposes disadvantage
Normal attack (no conditions): baseline without modifiers
Critical hit: natural 20 doubles dice, rage bonus
Turn end cleanup: temporary actions removed on Cleanup()
Disengaging prevents OA: DisengagingCondition -> MovementChain -> no OA
Normal movement triggers OA: goblin attacks when fighter leaves reach
Dash doubles movement: Dash ability grants speed as extra movement
UI end-to-end: Click Attack -> Strike appears -> Click enemy -> Attack executes
not_implemented: Full round with multiple characters (turn order)
